scientific_integrity: Analytical proof uses changed-coordinate partition and sharp four-symbol local bounds. Finite exhaustive checks: 65,376 centers, q=3..6 in bounded lengths. Historical equivalence remains a priority risk; no independent review.
scientific_limitations: Labeled q-ary proper path words; Hamming distance at most two; exact extremal formulas and rigidity for q>=3,n>=5, not cycles, color-quotient metrics, whole ball-volume distribution, or optimal code size.
title: Sharp radius-two constrained Hamming balls of proper words
